import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('magaza.db')
cur = conn.cursor()
# Müşteri-sehir eşleşmesi: her müşterinin şehri
cur.execute("SELECT DISTINCT m.sehir FROM musteriler m")
sehirler = [r[0] for r in cur.fetchall()]
print("Tüm şehirler:", sehirler)

# Her şehir için sipariş veren farklı müşteri sayısı
cur.execute("""
    SELECT m.sehir, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) 
    FROM musteriler m
    JOIN siparisler s ON s.musteri_id = m.id
    JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON sk.siparis_id = s.id
    GROUP BY m.sehir
""")
print("\nSipariş veren şehirler:")
for r in cur.fetchall():
    print(f"  {r}")

conn.close()

args.content:
WITH sehir_musteri_siparis AS (
    SELECT
        m.sehir,
        m.id AS musteri_id
    FROM musteriler m
    JOIN siparisler s ON s.musteri_id = m.id
    JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON sk.siparis_id = s.id
    GROUP BY m.sehir, m.id
),
sehir_stats AS (
    SELECT
        m.sehir,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS musteri_sayisi
    FROM musteriler m
    JOIN sehir_musteri_siparis sms ON sms.musteri_id = m.id
    GROUP BY m.sehir
),
sehir_ciro AS (
    SELECT
        m.sehir,
        SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat) AS toplam_ciro
    FROM musteriler m
    JOIN siparisler s ON s.musteri_id = m.id
    JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON sk.siparis_id = s.id
    GROUP BY m.sehir
)
SELECT
    m.sehir,
    COALESCE(s.sehir_stats.musteri_sayisi, 0) AS musteri_sayisi,
    ROUND(COALESCE(s.sehir_ciro.toplam_ciro, 0), 2) AS toplam_ciro
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sehir FROM musteriler) m
LEFT JOIN sehir_stats ON sehir_stats.sehir = m.sehir
LEFT JOIN sehir_ciro ON sehir_ciro.sehir = m.sehir
ORDER BY toplam_ciro DESC, m.sehir ASC;
